description:

To find out more about this course, see https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/courses/education-ba-hons

Students featuring in this film were paid for their time at the Cambridge Living Wage. Their views are their own.

Disclaimer: While every effort has been made to ensure that the information contained in this video is accurate at the time it was uploaded, changes are likely to occur. It is therefore very important that you check the University and College websites for any updates before you apply for the course by visiting www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk and again before accepting any offer to study at the University. Where there is a difference between the contents of this video and these websites, the contents of the website take precedence and represent the basis on which we intend to deliver our educational services to you.

title: Campuses and student life at UCPH
description:
The University of Copenhagen has four campus areas. As distances in Copenhagen are relatively small, it is easy to get from one campus to the other either by bicycle or public transportation. The campus areas are integrated into the city of Copenhagen and students use the facilities available in the city, adding a lively buzz to the streets and cafés of Copenhagen. 
The University premises range from historic buildings in the medieval city centre to modern buildings being constructed today to develop the campus areas and accommodate state-of-the-art research and teaching facilities.

title: 2026 苗栗大同高中｜LTU OSSD 台加高中雙聯學制說明會｜加拿大高中課程・海外大學升學規劃
description:
🎓 2026 苗栗大同高中｜LTU OSSD 台加高中雙聯學制說明會

高中階段除了準備台灣升學，也可以同步修讀加拿大高中課程，提早為加拿大、英國、美國、澳洲等海外大學做好準備。

本場說明會介紹 LTU OSSD 台加高中雙聯學制，帶領學生與家長認識加拿大安大略省高中教育制度（OSSD），包含課程安排、學分規劃、Grade 12 選課，以及未來海外大學申請方式。

📌 說明會重點

・什麼是加拿大 OSSD 高中文憑？
・台灣高中生如何同步修讀加拿大高中課程？
・OSSD 學分與畢業條件如何規劃？
・Grade 12 科目如何配合未來大學科系？
・加拿大、英國、美國、澳洲大學申請方式
・台灣高中課程與加拿大課程如何並行？
・海外短期交換與國際學習機會
・LTU 在台學習輔導與海外升學規劃

🌎 LTU OSSD 台加高中雙聯學制

學生可以在台灣高中就讀期間，同步累積加拿大高中課程與國際學習經驗，並依照未來的大學及科系方向提早規劃升學路徑。
